reasons.legacy-apps/hms/admin-panel1.php: timeline_list_while.json: the receptionist's appointment table (select * from appointmenttb). The contract says GET /api/appointments serves this timeline.
reasons.hand-written: list_foreach.php: timeline_list_foreach.json: the same page with foreach loops, so the same endpoint. The contract names both timelines on GET /api/appointments.
reasons.hand-written: admin_dashboard.php: timeline_admin.json: the authorization-guarded statistics block (total, revenue). The contract says GET /api/admin/appointment-stats serves it, and that the session values are deliberately not in its response.
reasons.legacy-apps/hms/admin-panel.php: timeline_detail.json: the signed-in patient's appointment history (filtered on $_SESSION values). The contract says GET /api/me/appointments serves it. The real page also renders other tabs; this mock covers only the history excerpt.
